blocks.title: Entropy
blocks.text: Entropy is baat ka measure (paimana) hai ke kisi fixed temperature par system ke andar energy kitne tareeqon se distribute ki (baanti) ja sakti hai.

Jab energy zyada tareeqon se baanti ja sake to system zyada stable hota hai. Entropy ko system ki randomness ya disorder (be-tarteebi) ka measure bhi samjha ja sakta hai. Jitna zyada disorder, utni zyada entropy. System jab zyada disordered hota hai to energy ke lihaz se zyada stable ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Kamre mein perfume ki boo phail jati hai, khud wapas bottle mein nahi aati. Phaili hui state mein molecules aur un ki energy ko arrange karne ke tareeqe kahin zyada hain, yani entropy zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek hi gas ke do samples (namoone) ek hi temperature par hain, magar ek ko double volume mein phailne diya gaya. Kis ki entropy zyada hai?
blocks.explanation: Bare volume wale ki. Us ke molecules aur un ki energy ziyada jagah mein kahin zyada tareeqon se arrange ho sakte hain, is liye entropy zyada hai.

items: Entropy (S): energy (aur particles) ko baantne ke tareeqon ki ginti, ya system ke disorder ka measure.
Zyada tareeqe = zyada disorder = zyada entropy = zyada stable.
